fullTextEN: We call it New Year's Eve
Why is it called New Year's Eve?

fullTextZH: 今天我来给你讲一讲除夕的传说
fullTextEN: Today I will tell you the legend of New Year's Eve
Everyone was very afraid of it

fullTextZH: 因为年在冬天的时候喜欢去村子里
fullTextEN: Because Nian liked to go to the village in winter
It went to watch and scare the villagers
Not only would it scare the villagers

fullTextZH: 大家都觉得年太可怕了
fullTextEN: Everyone thinks Nian is too scary.

fullTextZH: 我们不知道可以做什么
fullTextEN: We don't know what we can do.
This way Nian can't see them.

fullTextZH: 有一个老爷爷来到这个村子里
fullTextEN: An old man came to this village.
He heard the story of Nian.
You need to go to the mountain.
Nian is very fierce and scary.
You should be afraid of it.
I have a way to drive it away.

fullTextZH: 让它以后不来我们的村子
fullTextEN: Make it not come to our village again.
Do you have any other way?

fullTextZH: 大家想我们也没有别的办法
fullTextEN: Everyone thought, 'We also have no other way.'

fullTextZH: 好吧我们让这个老爷爷试一试吧
fullTextEN: Okay, let's let this old man try.
Okay, on New Year's Eve night.
I am very small, but the year is very big.

fullTextZH: 那我有什么东西可以帮我呢
fullTextEN: So what do I have that can help me?
Hmm, I don't have anything very big.

fullTextZH: 可是我有一些小的东西
fullTextEN: But I have some small things.
The old man thought for a long time.

fullTextZH: 然后老爷爷就在他的房子外面
fullTextEN: Then the old man was outside his house.
Oh, there is bamboo outside my house.
Bamboo has a lot of water.

fullTextZH: 烧的时候有很大的声音
fullTextEN: When burning, there is a loud sound.

fullTextZH: 老爷爷觉得他准备好了
fullTextEN: The old man thinks he is ready

fullTextZH: 我要去山上吃人和动物
fullTextEN: I want to go to the mountain to eat people and animals
In the past, this village was dark

fullTextZH: 然后他再看这个房子外面是什么东西
fullTextEN: Then he looked again at what was outside the house

fullTextZH: 这个是烧竹子的声音啊
fullTextEN: This is the sound of burning bamboo.
So Nian was scared to death.
It quickly ran back to the mountains.

fullTextZH: 它再也没有出来吃人和动物
fullTextEN: It never came out to eat people and animals again.

fullTextZH: 第二天大家回到村子里
fullTextEN: The next day everyone returned to the village.
You don't need to be afraid of Nian anymore.
It ran back to the mountains.

fullTextZH: 你怎么可能让年很害怕
fullTextEN: How could you make Nian so scared?

fullTextZH: 你快点告诉我们你做了什么
fullTextEN: Quickly tell us what you did.
Nian is afraid of three things.

fullTextZH: 所以我在我的家外面放了红色的纸
fullTextEN: So I put red paper outside my house.
It likes to come out at night.
So it is afraid of light.

fullTextZH: 年很害怕很大声的东西
fullTextEN: Nian is afraid of very loud things.

fullTextZH: 所以我烧竹子有很大的声音
fullTextEN: So I burned bamboo to make a loud sound.
You can do these three things.
Because it will be very afraid.

fullTextZH: 中国人除夕的时候有这3个传统
fullTextEN: Chinese people have these three traditions on New Year's Eve.
We need to put up Spring Festival couplets.
We don't sleep, we turn on the lights.

fullTextZH: 或者以前人们会点灯笼
fullTextEN: Or in the past, people would light lanterns.

fullTextZH: 我们会放很大声的东西
一家人我们在家里一起等新年到来
fullTextEN: The whole family waits at home together for the New Year to arrive.
This is the legend of Nian.
I hope you like this story.

fullTextEN: Do you want to hear more stories like this?
